note: Proposed (not-shipped) contract shape per docs/design/design-pipeline.md §2 S5 and the design-sizing skill. Device W/L are in microns (sky130_fd_pr subckt convention). last_sim_result references the S10 corner-sweep artifacts this sizing was converged against.

sizing_rationale.tail_current: 20 uA nominal, split 10 uA per input-pair device; sets GBW = gm1/(2*pi*CL) with headroom over the 5 MHz target.
sizing_rationale.input_pair: W/L = 8/0.5 um for gm ~30 uS at ID=10 uA (moderate inversion); L=0.5 um (well above minimum) for adequate ro per the KB entry's sky130 low-intrinsic-gain caveat.
sizing_rationale.pmos_load: W/L = 6/1 um; L=1 um raises the mirror's ro to lift single-ended output gain gm_in*(ro_n||ro_p).
sizing_rationale.tail_device: W/L = 10/1 um; L=1 um for high tail output impedance (CMRR floor per the KB sizing_approach).

loop_a_history.outcome: gain_db failed at 3 skewed corners (worst 19.3 dB @ sf/1.620V/-40C vs 30 dB target).
loop_a_history.diagnosis: Not a device-sizing deficiency: the naive open-loop testbench let the output float to a corner-dependent balance point that drifted near a rail at skewed corners, pushing a load device toward triode and collapsing measured gain. In the actual unity-gain buffer application the output is held at the common-mode point by feedback, so this was a characterization artifact.
loop_a_history.action: Corrected the S6 netlist's characterization methodology: added a DC feedback network (Lfb/Cfb) that holds out = vcm at DC while opening the loop at AC. No device sizes changed.

loop_a_history.outcome: All declared measurements pass across the full 5x2x2 corner matrix. See last_sim_result.

convergence.criterion: Loop A (design doc §1): every declared measurement status == pass across the full declared corner matrix for a stable candidate.
convergence.provenance_caveat: This is a SCHEMATIC-LEVEL (pre-layout) convergence via Loop A's fast S5->S6->S10 path. Per the design doc's S10 row, it does NOT satisfy the vision sentence's 'simulation-verified': that requires a post-extraction (S9->S10) pass, which is blocked on #54 (no extraction verb). See writeup.
